key_highlights: ASX tumbles as miners and banks sell off amid rising oil prices near $US100 and climbing bond yields
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; Chinese inflation surge complicates demand outlook
Australian business conditions at weakest since pandemic, signalling broad-based economic softening
Gas policy pivot: government softens local supply rules and abandons reservation, easing Asian energy fears but raising transition concerns
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk in financials
WA gold exploration sector active with multiple high-grade hits and funding rounds (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania)
High-end property sees steepest price falls while affordable segment remains resilient; NSW faces stamp duty revenue hit
Queensland on brink of credit rating downgrade, adding sovereign risk to state-linked exposures
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness and Chinese inflation pressure large-cap miners, but gold and copper exploration remain active. WA gold pipeline strong with multiple high-grade discoveries.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from iron ore softness. Gold juniors (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon) and copper (Flagship) offer relative strength. Diversification within materials is key.

sectors.trend: Banks under pressure from rising bond yields and private credit contagion (Bathla collapse). Credit quality concerns spreading.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression risk. Private credit exposure a key watch item. Defensive quality names may outperform.

sectors.trend: Oil near $US100 driven by Iran conflict; gas policy liberalisation; data centre power demand straining grid. Coal-to-data-centre pivot emerging.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from gas policy shift. Power generators face demand surge. LNG exporters gain from Asian demand. Energy transition disrupted by AI data centre load.

sectors.trend: Medicare review recommends rebate increases, supporting sector funding but raising fiscal cost concerns.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, HIC.AX benefit from policy support. Budget pressure may cap upside. Defensive positioning intact.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. NSW stamp duty revenue hit. Housing market debate intensifies.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals. High-end residential developers under pressure. Monitor RBA response to housing data.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic. Migrant labour and sham contracting issues. Austal $1.9b bid signals M&A activity.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, COL.AX face demand softness. Austal (AUS.AX) M&A catalyst. Consumer discretionary at risk.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge FX exposure; monitor RBA communications; rising yields may force rate hold or hike despite weak business conditions

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore weakness spreading; Chinese inflation and demand concerns; gold/copper offer better risk-reward

defensive_moves.recommendation: Favour large-cap diversified banks; avoid private credit-heavy lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals private credit stress; CBA and NAB have broader diversification and stronger capital buffers

defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker risk with oil at $100 and weak business conditions; CSL and WES offer defensive income

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QLD-linked and high-end property exposures
defensive_moves.rationale: Queensland downgrade risk; luxury property in steepest correction; NSW stamp duty hit signals fiscal stress

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Oil at $100, rising bond yields, and iron ore weakness cap upside. RBA caught between weak business conditions and inflation from energy. Expect volatility around ^AXJO. Gold and gas names outperform; iron ore and banks lag. Bathla fallout may trigger further private credit stress.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and Chinese demand stabilises. WA gold pipeline and copper/battery tech offer structural growth. Gas policy reform supports energy sector. Housing bifurcation continues. Data centre power demand creates long-term infrastructure investment theme. Key risk: prolonged Iran conflict or Chinese hard landing.
